title: Transparent Glass Avatar
content:
I want to Learn how to turn your Avatar into a transparent glass Avatar and as all of the community members being my Seniors and my Teachers can guide me through the process and I would if any one can share the Avatar file with me

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/2d4caaa775644b1eb267ffeca47e48b3 This free file includes powerful crystal glass and PVC overlay materials. Explore the setup, study the material workflow, and learn how transparent effects are created inside CLO3D and Marvelous Designer.👍🏻
Reply 1: ❤️

Comment 2: Hi and welcome! Turning the avatar to Glass is fast and easy. You can select the Avatar om the 3D window > Go to the Property Editor > Change Material type to Glass.Just keep in mind Glass is render only so you will only see it in the Render EngineFor further support please make sure to post your from your account that has a valid CLO license 🙂
Reply 1: ❤️ I Will keep it in mind
content_description: This web page is dedicated to learning how to create a transparent glass Avatar with guidance from experienced community members and sharing Avatar files for collaboration.
